title: ScorerResult
description: Block 5 output. Uniform return of every grounding scorer (embedding / NLI / LLM-judge baseline). Block 6 maps score + thresholds -> verdict.

method.description: scorer id, e.g. bge-m3-cosine | hw1-selfattn | ragas-llm-judge | nli-true | selfcheckgpt

deterministic.description: true for embedding/NLI (fixed weights, no sampling); false for LLM-judge baselines
